::: {.obsidian-exit-interview}
:::

State the purpose of the interview in one paragraph. Record the
employee's reasons for leaving in their own words.

# The role

Record the employee's view of the role. Note what they enjoyed and
what they found difficult.

# The team and management

Record the employee's view of the team and the management style.

# Pay and conditions

Record the employee's view of pay, benefits, and working
conditions.

# Suggestions

Record any suggestions for improvement the employee offers.

# Next steps

Record the handover status and any actions the organisation will
take.
